data_protocol.final_test_policy: One final evaluation after the fixed configuration and validation selections; an ignored ledger rejects a repeated candidate evaluation.
data_protocol.future_leakage: Only train/history labels fit NCDM and rate baselines. Validation selects all candidates and the comparator before the final test rows are opened.
data_protocol.split: Per-student chronological 60/20/20 with time_done ascending and original source-row tie-breaker.

fine_concept_to_topic_aggregation.projection: Mean fine ModelConcept mastery over the catalog's one-Topic-per-Exercise membership; display-layer Topic IDs are never reused as fine ModelConcept IDs.

hyperparameters.comparison_boundary: C40_TOPIC and C_FINE_EXERCISE use this same architecture and optimizer schedule. Only Q-matrix and ModelConcept cardinality differ.
hyperparameters.onehot_q_execution: Algebraically equivalent first-layer selection for the sole nonzero Q input; it preserves NCDM parameters and interaction equations while avoiding known-zero dense multiplications.
hyperparameters.reference_component: InsCD NCDM / Default extractor / NCD_IF equations through the archived split-safe adapter.

C40_TOPIC.reference_component: InsCD NCDM / Default extractor / NCD_IF equations through the archived split-safe adapter.

test_auc_vs_selected_nonpersonalized_bas.method: Paired nonparametric bootstrap over final-test interactions; report-only and not used for selection.
